failure_modes.failure_mode: Seal hides faint or crowded drawing content
failure_modes.effects: A dimension, revision or line can become unreadable in an issued drawing.
failure_modes.causes: Thresholding ignores faint ink; square grid search is approximate and crowded pages may have no blank disk.
failure_modes.prevention: Integral-image search evaluates eligible grid positions; ink minimization takes precedence over clearance.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Disk coverage orders review, but neither zero coverage nor the square score proves semantic clearance (SOP-001 A4).

rationale.severity: Hidden technical content requires withholding the affected output.
rationale.occurrence: Faint and crowded sheets are plausible inputs; no representative production frequency is measured.
rationale.detection: Synthetic numerical tests detect algorithm regressions, but faint content can escape the metric; human output review is required.

actions.description: Retain grid-reference tests and explicitly demonstrate the faint-ink blind spot.
actions.acceptance: Grid minimum matches brute force; a real faint vector crossing the disk can still report zero coverage. This characterizes a limit, not its elimination.

actions.description: Perform enlarged output review on faint, scanned and crowded sheets; evaluate adaptive thresholding only through a separate change request.
actions.acceptance: Record SOP-001 A4 on every output page and representative PQ examples. Open: no real-drawing PQ or automated semantic-clearance control is supplied.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Automatic seal clips off page or enters reserved corner
failure_modes.effects: Seal is incomplete or covers a revision/title-block region.
failure_modes.causes: Small sheets, fractional coordinates or keep-out settings leave no legal position.
failure_modes.prevention: Margins and keep-out reject invalid candidates; small-page fallback shrinks to fit or raises an explicit error.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Boundary tests and fully reserved-page refusal; SOP-001 A3 checks final geometry.

rationale.severity: An incomplete or misplaced seal invalidates the intended output.
rationale.occurrence: Edge cases are known but confined to constrained geometry; frequency is estimated.
rationale.detection: Deterministic geometry tests cover defined boundaries; actual drawing conventions still need visual checks.

actions.description: Keep fail-explicit and small-page geometry regression coverage.
actions.acceptance: Fully reserved page raises; small-page seal stays inside page and outside keep-out.

actions.description: Check legibility after any automatic shrink and confirm project keep-out dimensions before issue.
actions.acceptance: SOP-001 A3 confirms readable size and intended reserved area on every changed sheet size; no universal minimum legibility is inferred from fit tests.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Wrong or unrecognized designated cell is selected
failure_modes.effects: Seal may occupy a plausible but unintended title-block region.
failure_modes.causes: Label matching assumes extractable text and common spellings; scans and unusual ruling lines can defeat cell derivation.
failure_modes.prevention: Text-label search and line-derived cell bounds; fitting cell required, otherwise whitespace fallback.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Synthetic common-label and cell-fit tests plus operator inspection of the intended cell.

rationale.severity: Wrong title-block placement can obscure information or breach intended layout.
rationale.occurrence: Unfamiliar/scanned layouts are plausible; the fixture set is not a frequency sample.
rationale.detection: Tests cover known labels only; a false-positive cell can look credible and requires layout review.

actions.description: Maintain fitting-cell and label variants as regression evidence.
actions.acceptance: Synthetic designated cell is centered and fitted even when it overrides automatic keep-out; supported label variants are recognized.

actions.description: Qualify each new title-block family, including scans and multiple engineer labels, before relying on automatic cell detection.
actions.acceptance: Attach representative PQ results showing the intended cell or an explicitly reviewed manual placement; unfamiliar layouts remain unqualified.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Export differs from reviewed coordinates on rotated or offset pages
failure_modes.effects: Seal/date could be shifted over technical content or off sheet despite a plausible preview.
failure_modes.causes: Mixing displayed, rotated and MediaBox-origin coordinate systems.
failure_modes.prevention: Separate derotation handling for image and text insertion; explicit origin corrections.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Rendered PDF geometry regressions for four right-angle rotations and nonzero origins; downloaded PDF is reference.

rationale.severity: Shifted overlay can hide technical content.
rationale.occurrence: Rotation/origin variants occur but are bounded cases covered by tests; estimate only.
rationale.detection: Tests measure actual exported geometry; preview alone would miss insertion-only errors.

actions.description: Retain exported-image and text geometry checks across supported rotations.
actions.acceptance: Exported overlay bounds match displayed placement for 0/90/180/270 degrees and offset origins.

actions.description: Inspect downloaded PDFs for each incoming rotation/crop convention, especially beyond the synthetic fixtures.
actions.acceptance: SOP-001 A3/A4 recorded on final files; untested crop conventions require a new fixture and PQ review.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Stale automatic location or manual override reaches export
failure_modes.effects: Changed settings can leave an automatic seal in a forbidden corner; an intentional manual move can cover content.
failure_modes.causes: Session/cache reuse or an operator overrides keep-out; manual placements are deliberately not relocated.
failure_modes.prevention: Placement/render cache keys and download-time sanitization; manual decisions preserved with UI warning.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Live download tests confirm stale relocation and preservation of manual edits; review still required for overrides.

rationale.severity: Stale or manual position can obscure critical content.
rationale.occurrence: Settings changes and manual adjustments are routine opportunities, not measured incident rates.
rationale.detection: Automatic stale-corner checks are tested; manual content overlap is not prevented.

actions.description: Retain end-to-end downloaded-byte tests for late stale state and explicit manual edits.
actions.acceptance: Late automatic placement is sanitized and downloaded bytes reflect deliberate edits/removals.

actions.description: Record each manual override and independently verify final clearance after bulk apply or settings changes.
actions.acceptance: SOP-001 stamping record lists manual changes and A3/A4 results. Automatic tests do not authorize manual keep-out overlap.

failure_modes.failure_mode: A required page is missed or an excluded page is stamped
failure_modes.effects: Incomplete or incorrectly stamped drawing set is handed over.
failure_modes.causes: Riskiest-first ordering differs from page order; remove/restore decisions or bulk downloads are misunderstood.
failure_modes.prevention: Per-page placements retain indices; removal is explicit; downloads preserve source page count.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Ten-sheet export and removal tests; SOP-001 A1/A2 compares source and issued set.

rationale.severity: Wrong scope of stamping requires stopping issue and regenerating affected files.
rationale.occurrence: Multi-page and manual removal workflows create plausible human error opportunities.
rationale.detection: Tests detect indexing/export regressions; software cannot infer which pages ought to be sealed.

actions.description: Keep multi-page export and manual removal regression checks.
actions.acceptance: Synthetic ten-sheet set retains every page and expected seal; explicit removals reach downloaded PDF.

actions.description: Reconcile page count, sheet identifiers and expected seal presence against the authorized source set.
actions.acceptance: Record A1/A2 for each file, including intended omissions, before issue. No automatic engineering-scope determination exists.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Original content is degraded or unintentionally flattened
failure_modes.effects: Selectable text, vector fidelity or embedded raster data can be lost.
failure_modes.causes: Wrong output option or a PDF writer regression rewrites original streams.
failure_modes.prevention: Default overlay path retains original streams; raster flattening is an explicit choice.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Content-stream/raster preservation and optional-flatten tests; compare downloaded output to original.

rationale.severity: Loss of original drawing fidelity can affect interpretation.
rationale.occurrence: Overlay is default and tested; accidental flatten selection remains plausible.
rationale.detection: Tests compare streams and raster bytes; output review must confirm the chosen export mode.

actions.description: Retain original-content and optional-flatten regressions.
actions.acceptance: Original raster bytes remain exact in overlay mode; flattening is exercised only when requested.

actions.description: Confirm the required export mode and retain unchanged source files/checksums.
actions.acceptance: SOP-001 A6 plus release record states whether flattening was explicitly required; real drawing fidelity remains a PQ check.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Wrong date or caption obscures content outside scored footprint
failure_modes.effects: Output misstates intended date/scope or a caption collides with drawing content despite zero disk coverage.
failure_modes.causes: Default date is accepted without checking; caption below the circle is excluded from collision scoring.
failure_modes.prevention: Editable date/caption, selectable text insertion and small-seal date font sizing; caption can be cleared.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Exported-text and caption-boundary tests; SOP-001 A5 requires checking actual output.

rationale.severity: Misleading date/scope or obscured technical content requires withholding output.
rationale.occurrence: Default values and tight cells are plausible recurring workflow conditions; no measured rate.
rationale.detection: String tests prove selected values render, not that they are authorized; disk coverage does not detect caption collisions.

actions.description: Document the caption footprint limit with exported-PDF geometry and retain date/text checks.
actions.acceptance: Chosen date/caption render; small date is not dropped; caption bounds demonstrate extension beyond scored disk.

actions.description: Confirm authorized date/caption and inspect space below the seal; move, shorten or clear caption if needed. Consider expanded collision bounds in a separate change.
actions.acceptance: Record A4/A5 on downloaded output. Caption-aware automatic clearance and project authorization are not implemented by these tests.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Wrong or damaged seal image is used
failure_modes.effects: Output carries the wrong identity or an unreadable/incomplete seal.
failure_modes.causes: Operator selects wrong asset; white-background/crop processing damages image; replacing a file reuses stale bytes.
failure_modes.prevention: Content hash, transparent-background preparation and seal cache invalidation.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Image-processing and file-replacement regressions plus operator thumbnail/output identity check.

rationale.severity: Wrong seal identity is an authorization-critical error even if placement is correct.
rationale.occurrence: Manual selection and asset replacement are plausible but unmeasured opportunities.
rationale.detection: Tests verify pixels/cache identity only; there is no automated identity or authorization verification.

actions.description: Keep transparent-image and content-hash/cache replacement tests.
actions.acceptance: White background becomes transparent while ring ink survives. Identical source bytes yield stable hash, changed input changes it, and replacing a seal refreshes bytes. Identity remains a human check.

actions.description: Confirm the current authorized seal with its custodian and inspect preparation for clipping before any issue.
actions.acceptance: SOP-001 prerequisites 2/3 and thumbnail/output checks recorded privately; no real seal, signature or authorization record is published.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Skipped or failed input is mistaken for a completed zero-coverage page
failure_modes.effects: Missing/unprocessed drawing is omitted from the issued set or incorrectly considered safe.
failure_modes.causes: Unreadable/password-protected input or raster-analysis failure is ignored.
failure_modes.prevention: Input validation states a skip reason; analysis failure raises with page number rather than guessed zero coverage.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Bad-input and injected analysis-failure tests; operator reconciles uploaded versus exported files.

rationale.severity: Omitted processing can lead to an incomplete drawing set.
rationale.occurrence: Unsupported or damaged PDFs are occasional plausible inputs, not measured frequency.
rationale.detection: Explicit errors make detection strong when attended; operator can still ignore a skipped file.

actions.description: Retain rejected-input reasons and fail-explicit analysis checks.
actions.acceptance: Bad/encrypted input is rejected with a reason and an analysis failure identifies the page.

actions.description: Resolve every skip/error and reconcile the source file list before handing over output.
actions.acceptance: Each expected source has an output or documented intentional exclusion; unresolved processing error blocks issue under SOP-001 section 8.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Applying an image is mistaken for engineering approval
failure_modes.effects: A drawing may be issued without the responsible engineer authorizing the seal or reviewing the design.
failure_modes.causes: Automation is treated as approval; tool has no login, signature verification or approval audit trail.
failure_modes.prevention: SOP-001 requires written authorization and engineer-of-record sign-off; tool permits correction/removal but does not enforce approval.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Independent procedural authorization check; UI/export tests only establish editing fidelity.

rationale.severity: Unauthorized issue is a serious process failure regardless of geometrically correct placement.
rationale.occurrence: There is a credible misuse path; no field incident frequency or permission model is claimed.
rationale.detection: Software cannot detect lack of authority; detection depends on external review and records.

actions.description: Retain tested ability to remove/move seals and choose output text; do not label it approval enforcement.
actions.acceptance: Output follows operator decisions and text settings only. Tests do not verify professional authority or authorize any issue.

actions.description: Require written engineer authorization, independent final checking and controlled issue records outside this tool.
actions.acceptance: SOP-001 prerequisites and handover records complete; this public demonstration has no production approval, real-drawing PQ or electronic-signature claim.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Confidential drawings or real seals leave the intended local workflow
failure_modes.effects: Private project content or seal identity could be exposed.
failure_modes.causes: A future network dependency or accidental commit bypasses local-processing/public-fixture conventions.
failure_modes.prevention: Local stamper pipeline and ignored private asset directories; only generated fixtures belong in the public repository.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Static no-network-import test for stamper plus human staged-diff inspection; not a whole-system security audit.

rationale.severity: Exposure of seal/client data is an authorization-critical failure.
rationale.occurrence: Accidental publishing is possible; no organization-specific incident data is available.
rationale.detection: Import checks cover only stamper, not arbitrary file copies, browser behavior or transitive network activity.

actions.description: Retain the package network-import boundary test.
actions.acceptance: stamper has no imports from the tested network-module set. This does not prove system-wide data isolation.

actions.description: Review staged changes and generated artifacts before publication; keep real drawings and seals in controlled local storage.
actions.acceptance: Public commits contain generated fixtures and source only; private asset/data review recorded locally, without adding those records to Git.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Dependency incompatibility prevents reliable visual review
failure_modes.effects: Operator cannot reliably inspect previews and could proceed with incomplete review.
failure_modes.causes: Media response headers/gzip behavior change across UI dependency versions.
failure_modes.prevention: Pinned direct/transitive dependencies with verified media compatibility.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Identity/gzip HTTP response tests and operator preview check.

rationale.severity: Review interruption is visible and recoverable before issue when SOP is followed.
rationale.occurrence: Pinned versions limit drift; compatibility regression remains plausible.
rationale.detection: Response tests exercise both encodings and a missing preview is generally visible.

actions.description: Keep preview response tests on the pinned runtime.
actions.acceptance: Media responses provide correct HTTP headers under identity and gzip encoding.

actions.description: Stop issue when preview cannot be inspected; qualify the packaged Windows runtime separately before deployment.
actions.acceptance: Correct runtime installed and every page inspected; Windows packaging/browser coverage is not claimed by source-environment tests.

failure_modes.failure_mode: FMEA actions or validation evidence silently become stale
failure_modes.effects: A change ships with unsupported mitigations, invalid scoring or obsolete test links.
failure_modes.causes: Requirement/test renaming, missing actions or edited source leaves quality records disconnected.
failure_modes.prevention: Versioned JSON register, generated reports, exact requirement/test linking, fingerprint and PR CI gates.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Validator corruption/staleness tests, traceability check and IQ/OQ fingerprint check.

rationale.severity: False confidence in evidence can conceal regressions; application output still has a separate inspection step.
rationale.occurrence: Changes routinely alter tests/requirements; frequency of an actual escape is unknown.
rationale.detection: CI detects defined integrity errors; neither report generation nor tests prove adequacy of engineering judgment.

actions.description: Validate scores, ownership/status, exact related test IDs, high-severity review priority and generated-report freshness in CI.
actions.acceptance: Invalid/unrelated evidence fails; stale report returns nonzero without overwrite; S >= 8 triggers review even at low RPN.

actions.description: Reassess scores/actions after deviations, new drawing families or changes to placement/export/settings/dependencies.
actions.acceptance: Review FMEA with each change request, rerun CI/IQ-OQ and document representative PQ before production. Open actions require real evidence, not merely a linked test name.

failure_modes.failure_mode: CAD sheet omits referenced content or places a seal at the wrong printed size
failure_modes.effects: An incomplete or misleading review drawing is exported, or a seal covers drawing content.
failure_modes.causes: Missing/nested references, wrong paper units or origins, hidden layers, unsupported CAD objects or an unreviewed manual position.
failure_modes.prevention: Bind references bottom-up, reject missing/cyclic paths, preserve paper units and origin, contain the seal block, and refuse output overwrite.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Real DXF/DWG roundtrips, PDF page/ink checks, generated sample plots and an explicit user review step.

rationale.severity: A misleading drawing can inform a bad engineering decision; applying the seal itself is not approval.
rationale.occurrence: The tests cover synthetic 2D sheets; the variety and frequency of unsupported production CAD content are unknown.
rationale.detection: Automated checks catch defined reference, geometry and plotting errors; real sheet completeness and overlap still require review.

actions.description: Run file/reference, paper-space seal, physical plot and CLI tests, including real ODA conversion in its CI job.
actions.acceptance: Reopened outputs retain seal inserts and reference geometry; expected dimensions and ink are verified; closed outlines remain hollow.

actions.description: Review representative real sheets, fonts, title blocks and seal overlap before production use; use native CAD plotting for unsupported content.
actions.acceptance: Record a manual review of every intended drawing family. Generated examples do not establish production suitability.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Readiness or IP decision cites missing or invented evidence
failure_modes.effects: A release or research proposal overstates the available support.
failure_modes.causes: Paths move, patent numbers are mistyped or external publication metadata changes.
failure_modes.prevention: Dated reviewed publication register; explicit public-prototype TRL scope and unresolved field gates.
failure_modes.detection_controls: Offline path and citation checks in CI; optional live number/title verification. Neither establishes legal status or field readiness.

rationale.severity: An unsupported decision can waste pilot resources; this document does not authorise drawing issue.
rationale.occurrence: Manual citation edits and source changes are plausible, with no measured rate.
rationale.detection: Automated checks catch broken citations, but interpretation needs qualified review.

actions.description: Reject missing paths, unreviewed numbers and mismatched live publication identity.
actions.acceptance: Valid evidence passes; broken citations, invented numbers, mismatched metadata and network failure are rejected.

actions.description: Obtain supervised pilot evidence and professional IP review before broader commercial release.
actions.acceptance: Record fixed-release field outcomes and legal review privately. Citation integrity is not acceptance of maturity or freedom to operate.
